description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kiribathkubura, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320552
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in Kiribathkumbura. The content focuses entirely on land ownership, title registration, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
